blocks.stop_condition: Open a docs-only PR and reach MERGE_READY; never merge automatically.
blocks.prompt: Create exactly one file: docs/COPILOT_AGENT_TASK_LIVE_PROBE.md. The file must contain a short heading 'AlmaGo Copilot Agent Task Live Probe' and one sentence stating that it is a non-production connectivity probe for the bounded AlmaGo Autopilot. Do not modify any other file. Do not change workflows, product code, tests, dependencies, Auth, RLS, Supabase, migrations, secrets, billing, production data or deployment. Open a pull request and stop.
